isomorphisms.name: Shannon Channel Capacity to Spiritual Reception
isomorphisms.chi_law: C_i = A_i * log2(1 + T_i/D_i) maps directly to spiritual reception capacity, with A as soul bandwidth, T as truth signal, D as sin/noise
isomorphisms.physics_process: Shannon-Hartley theorem for channel capacity over a noisy channel
isomorphisms.theological_phenomenon: Variable reception of divine truth across individuals despite identical broadcast
isomorphisms.prediction: Sanctification corresponds to sustained increase in channel capacity (dC/dt > 0) via increasing A or decreasing D
physics_process_steps: Define channel capacity C = B * log2(1 + S/N)
Identify bandwidth B as receiver processing capacity
Identify signal S as transmitted information
Identify noise N as interference corrupting signal
Capacity increases logarithmically with S/N
At high noise, capacity ≈ B * S/(N ln2)
At low noise, capacity ≈ B * log2(S/N)
Capacity diverges as N → 0
mapped_text_steps: Define spiritual channel capacity C_i = A_i * log2(1 + T_i/D_i)
Identify soul bandwidth A_i as receiver's processing capacity
Identify truth T_i as divine broadcast aligned with reality
Identify drift D_i as sin/distortion corrupting channel
Spiritual capacity grows logarithmically with T/D
At high noise (D >> T): capacity ≈ A_i * T_i/(D_i ln2)
At low noise (D << T): capacity ≈ A_i * log2(T_i/D_i)
No-drift condition D → 0 implies infinite capacity
preserved_transitions: Bandwidth → Soul bandwidth (A_i): both limit maximum throughput
Signal-to-noise ratio → Truth-to-drift ratio (T_i/D_i): both determine capacity logarithmically
Noise floor → Sin/distortion (D_i): both reduce effective reception
Capacity divergence at zero noise → Perfection opens infinite reception
Logarithmic scaling → Diminishing returns on truth increase
missing_transitions: No explicit mapping for channel coding or error correction in spiritual domain
isomorphisms.notes: Mapping is exceptionally strong: every term in Shannon's equation has a direct spiritual analog with identical mathematical behavior. The logarithmic structure, asymptotic limits, and monotonicity all preserve. The only gap is the absence of an error-correction analog, but the text does not claim one.
